title: Engineering Compensation Bands — Confidential
body: CONFIDENTIAL — HR only. Engineering compensation bands (base salary, USD, annual): L3 Software Engineer $120,000–$145,000; L4 Software Engineer $145,000–$175,000; L5 Senior Software Engineer $175,000–$210,000; L6 Staff Engineer $210,000–$250,000; L6 Tech Lead $220,000–$260,000. Bands are reviewed annually each January. Equity grants are handled separately by Finance and are not reflected here. Do not share these figures outside HR and the compensation committee.
